summary: An ambient worship pad firmware: 16 scenes, each stacking four voices around a major key you choose, with a global effects chain for pads and atmosphere.
features: Four layered voices per scene; play any voice live or record into the sequence
SPACE knob adds grains, shimmer, reverb and echo at once
Global chain: DIRT, TONE, granular TEXTURE, plate reverb and tape echo
Built-in piano, marimba and glockenspiel samples
16 user preset slots and four screen themes
Works on newer FM-1s from 2.0.2; 1.x projects do not carry over
